grammar.label: will — spontaneous decisions, offers, promises
grammar.meaning: a decision made at the moment of speaking

explanation.en: Use will when you decide as you speak. For a plan you already had, use 'going to'.
explanation.uz: Gapirayotgan paytda qaror qilsangiz — will. Oldindan reja bo'lsa — going to.

grammar.positive_example: That bag looks heavy. I will help you.
grammar.negative_example: That bag looks heavy. I am going to help you.

l1_notes.uz: 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q va shaxs bo'yicha o'zgarmaydi.

grammar.label: will vs going to
grammar.meaning: spontaneous decision vs existing plan or visible evidence

explanation.en: Already decided, or you can see it coming: going to. Deciding right now, or just an opinion: will.
explanation.uz: Oldindan qaror qilingan yoki ko'rinib turgan dalil bor — going to. Aynan hozir qaror yoki shunchaki fikr — will.

grammar.positive_example: Look at those clouds — it is going to rain.
grammar.negative_example: Look at those clouds — it will rain.

l1_notes.uz: Dalil ko'rinsa yoki reja tayyor bo'lsa — going to.

grammar.label: because / because of; so / so that
grammar.form: because + clause; because of + noun; so + result

explanation.en: 'because' is followed by a subject and verb; 'because of' by a noun.
explanation.uz: 'because' dan keyin ega + fe'l; 'because of' dan keyin ot.

grammar.positive_example: We stayed home because of the rain.
grammar.negative_example: We stayed home because the rain.
